# FDG5030

> DO preserve the previous value if a property setter throws an exception.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2 Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: whether a setter keeps the previous value when it throws would need data-flow analysis of the setter.
